purpose: Remove a full sparse-logit-vector copy from every decode step while preserving the exact locked greedy repetition and n-gram semantics.

triggering_measurement.current_behavior: Copy every local-logit value, alter only repetition or blocked indices, take argmax, discard the copy.
triggering_measurement.required_gain: Recover at least the measured 0.686 percentage-point gap to the sealed-parent retention floor.

single_allowed_change.new_behavior: Temporarily modify only the indexed repetition/blocked elements in the existing output array, compute the same argmax, and restore every touched value in a finally block.

pre_benchmark_requirements: Randomized equivalence against an independent copy-based reference over dense and sparse token maps.
Exact restoration of every input logits array, including overlapping repetition and blocked indices.
Exact v44 generated token/output identity over all nine English routes.
promotion_rule: Rerun the full sustained benchmark on v44 under the new hash-reported runner. If it passes, rerun functional quality, general preservation, headline, physical, identity, and adversarial gates on the same artifact and runner.
failure_rule: If exact equivalence or sustained speed fails, close this runner branch.
